## Core pages

- [SkillTa — AI Career Quiz & Roadmaps 2027](https://www.skillta.tech/index.md): AI-powered career quiz + personalized roadmaps for 50+ tech careers. Find your ideal path in 5 minutes. For students, freshers & switchers.

Career quiz, 50+ roadmaps, salary insights, and personalized recommendations for students, freshers & career switchers.
- [Contact SkillTa — Career Guidance Support & Feedback](https://www.skillta.tech/contact.md): Have questions about your tech career path? Need guidance on choosing a career? Reach out to the SkillTa team. We respond within 24-48 hours.
- [Compare Tech Careers 2027 — Salary, Skills & Demand](https://www.skillta.tech/compare.md): Side-by-side comparison of 50+ tech careers. Compare salary, difficulty, skills & demand. Frontend vs Backend, AI vs DevOps & more.
- [Tech Career Blog 2027 — Guides & Salary Tips](https://www.skillta.tech/blog.md): Expert guides, salary insights & career comparisons. Everything freshers & students need to succeed in tech. Updated for 2027.
- [The SkillTa Story](https://www.skillta.tech/story.md): Why SkillTa was built and how plan purchases and guest advertising support the platform.
- [Tech Salary Predictor](https://www.skillta.tech/salary-predictor.md): Estimate tech salary by role, experience, location and skills.
- [AI Resume Reviewer](https://www.skillta.tech/resume-reviewer.md): Review a resume for ATS compatibility, keyword gaps and improvement suggestions.
- [Resume Version Control — Track ATS Score Evolution | SkillTa](https://www.skillta.tech/resume-version-control.md): GitHub-style commit timeline for your resume. Track ATS score evolution, file history, and role-specific versions with secure cloud storage.
